svg.title: Mature monthly activity by first-observed cohort
svg.desc: Two heatmaps show observed active-customer fraction by first-observed cohort month and activity-month index. Complete month-zero cells are cohort entry. The partial December 2011 cohort month and later incomplete or future cells are gray and not treated as zero.
svg.text: Cell value = customers with a qualifying purchase day in that complete calendar month ÷ first-observed cohort size
Index 0 is cohort entry (100% by construction when fully observed), not repeat retention. Gray cells are incomplete or not observed.
Only fully observed calendar months through November 2011 are colored. The source ends partway through December 2011.
